name: Z2 + Sprints
description: 45min Z2 (145-180W, cad 88+) then 5 × 15sec ALL-OUT sprints in the last 15min. Rolling start, 3-4min full recovery between sprints.
notes: Z2 endurance + short neural sprints at the end. Sprints tacked onto Z2 maintain sprint capacity without stealing recovery from VO2/threshold days.

name: Z2 + Neural Sprints
description: 60min Z2 then 6 × 10-15sec ALL-OUT sprints in the last 15min. Rolling start, 3-4min full recovery between sprints.
notes: Neural sprint session: 6 short all-out efforts to maintain fast-twitch during the aerobic-focused phase. Keeps sprint pathways firing.
